sub_agent_reviews.summary: One unified Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; Chai was selected for low duplicate risk and strong AI-for-security evidence.
The full 17-page PDF was read and converted into a standalone Chinese Markdown deep dive.
The article explains differential testing, discrepancy tracing, UCB1 lease allocation, protocol harnesses, baselines, results, and disclosure limits.
The article separates confirmed findings from under-disclosure findings and states that code/data were not publicly available.
Third-party search found only arXiv aggregators and social reposts; the paper remains the source of truth.
The page uses pure Markdown with tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external image URLs are embedded.
